mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.floorage), 0) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.floorage FROM room_rent_record a JOIN room_rent_record_room b ON a.id = b.record_id JOIN room c ON b.room_id = c.id WHERE a.`status` = 'NORMAL') a

SELECT d.area_id areaId, COALESCE(e.num, 0) / d.num * 100 as num FROM (SELECT area_id, SUM(floorage) num FROM room GROUP BY area_id) d LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.area_id, SUM(c.floorage) num FROM room_rent_record a JOIN room_rent_record_room b ON a.id = b.record_id JOIN room c ON b.room_id = c.id WHERE a.`status` = 'NORMAL' GROUP BY c.area_id) e ON d.area_id = e.area_id
SELECT id FROM room_rent_record WHERE room_ids like concat('%', #{id}, '%') and status in ('NORMAL', 'EXPIRE')
